Markets.title: Varmora Granito raises Rs 212.4 crore from anchor investors ahead of Rs 708 crore IPO
Markets.summary: Varmora Granito raised ₹212.4 crore from 17 anchor investors ahead of its ₹708-crore initial public offering. Key participants in the share allocation included Goldman Sachs, ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, and Bandhan Mutual Fund.

Markets.title: Can Varmora Granito IPO deliver long-term growth for high-risk investors?
Markets.summary: Varmora Granito is launching a ₹320 crore IPO to fund capital projects and pay off debt, which will reduce the promoter's stake to 47 percent. Although the company improved its EBITDA margin, high-risk investors must weigh potential geopolitical tensions and export market concentration.

Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks climb after tech shares power Wall Street
Markets.summary: Asian stocks rose 0.5%, led by gains among memory chipmakers like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. This followed a strong Wall Street session where the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 achieved their best performance since early August.

Markets.title: Explained: 13 reasons why the Nifty could not deliver more in last 5 years
Markets.summary: Over the last five years, thirteen underperforming stocks dragged down the overall returns of the Nifty 50 index. Active mutual funds achieved better results by reducing their exposure to these specific laggards.

Markets.title: Stocks in news: ONGC, Lloyds Metals, Canara Bank, Rays of Belief and GRSE
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets closed higher on Monday, with several companies expected to be active in upcoming trading. Notable developments include ONGC's gas discovery in the Mahanadi Offshore Basin, Canara Bank's new rating from Moody’s, and Lloyds Metals and Energy's approval for capacity expansion.

Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: Indian equity markets rose on Monday as falling crude oil prices and heavy domestic buying offset foreign selling. The Indian Rupee also strengthened during the session due to the lower oil rates.

Geo-Political.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
Geo-Political.summary: Yemenis are fleeing across the Red Sea to Djibouti as the war between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalates. BBC journalist Frank Gardner spoke with some of these refugees about their escape.

Geo-Political.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
Geo-Political.summary: CNN, MSNBC, and Politico filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration following a White House press ban. In response, major United States television networks suspended their coverage of the president's travel to the United Nations summit in New York.

Geo-Political.title: Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'
Geo-Political.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has promised to keep his governing coalition together despite heavy losses in recent state elections. Merz stated that these electoral defeats transcend his personal leadership and threaten the country's democratic future.

Geo-Political.title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
Geo-Political.summary: Dr Vincent Brown, formerly known as Dr Vincent Bajinya, faces seven charges at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Tuesday. These are the first UK charges brought in connection with the 1994 Rwanda genocide.

Geo-Political.title: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
Geo-Political.summary: Millions of people in Japan were urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan struck the country. Although the meteorological agency previously warned of an imminent threat to life, that specific warning has since been downgraded.

Geo-Political.title: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
Geo-Political.summary: Vladimir Putin secured a predictable victory in Russia's presidential election. The Kremlin will likely use these results to claim widespread public support for the war in Ukraine.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth eases as coal, oil output contracts
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth slowed in August due to contractions in coal, oil, natural gas, and fertilizer production. Gains in cement, electricity, and iron ore were not enough to offset these declines.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA to come into force on 20 October: Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: India and New Zealand's Free Trade Agreement will come into force on October 20. Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal stated that the two nations aim to double bilateral trade to ₹35,000 crore by 2030.

Data & Insights.title: India-Canada CEPA: Fifth round of trade talks to begin Oct 5; Goyal says next 90 days ‘defining’ for bilateral ties
Data & Insights.summary: India and Canada will resume negotiations for a bilateral trade agreement on October 5, aiming to finalize the deal by the end of 2026. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that the upcoming 90 days will be defining for their economic relations.

Data & Insights.title: Mint explainer: why has India’s Income Tax Department stepped up its international outreach?
Data & Insights.summary: India's Income Tax Department is using overseas units to explain new tax laws to foreign entities. These units provide clarity on cross-border taxation, transfer pricing, tax treaties, and investment rules.

Data & Insights.title: Govt plans  ₹10,000-crore push to modernise India’s weather forecasting
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian finance ministry is reviewing a proposed 10,000-crore rupee initiative by the ministry of earth sciences to modernize weather forecasting. The plan focuses on upgrading prediction models and establishing a reliable early-warning system across the country.

Data & Insights.title: China drives India’s BRICS export surge to $19.9 billion; shipments to Japan, Italy, S Korea also gain
Data & Insights.summary: India's exports to BRICS nations surged 34% from April to August in the 2026-27 fiscal year, led by a 39% increase in shipments to China. During the same period, exports to Japan jumped 43% due to higher demand for energy products and electronics.

India.title: UN General Assembly 2026: S Jaishankar Holds Talks On Global, Regional Issues
India.summary: Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar discussed the Ukraine and Gulf crises, along with regional and global issues, during the UN General Assembly. He also exchanged views on multilateral topics, including the reform of the UN Security Council.

India.title: Odisha SIR: More Than 20 Lakh Voters Deleted From Electoral Roll
India.summary: More than 20 lakh voters were removed from the electoral roll during the Special Intensive Revision in Odisha. The removals included over 8.3 lakh deceased voters and more than 8 lakh voters who had permanently shifted.

India.title: Delhi PG Building Collapse: Court Extends Judicial Custody Of 6 Accused
India.summary: A Delhi court has extended the judicial custody of six accused individuals following a building collapse. The property had been leased to operators who ran it as a paying guest accommodation named 'Hostel Daze'.

India.title: 2 Workers Killed In Fire At Tyre Oil Factory In UP
India.summary: Two workers were killed in a fire that broke out at a tyre oil factory in Uttar Pradesh. The blaze started around 5:30 pm while six workers were loading tyres into a tank at the facility.

India.title: Man Kills Wife, Surrenders At Police Station In UP: Cops
India.summary: A man named Manish went to the Bhawanpur police station in Uttar Pradesh and confessed to killing his 25-year-old wife, Kavita. He informed the police that he had slit her throat at their home in Abdulapur.

India.title: On Groping Case, Bihar Minister's "Isolated Incidents Happen" Shocker
India.summary: A Bihar minister dismissed a recent groping incident in the state as an isolated occurrence that happens. In response, the opposition criticized the government, claiming women are unsafe under Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary's administration.

General.title: Airlines criticise air traffic control as second glitch causes more disruption
General.summary: Airlines criticized UK air traffic control following a second technical glitch that caused widespread travel disruption. Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that these recurring issues raise serious concerns about the organization's leadership.

General.title: UK to provide Saudi Arabia with 'defensive' military support, says Burnham
General.summary: The UK will provide defensive military support to Saudi Arabia following a request from the Saudi government. This support includes air-to-air refuelling to help the nation defend against attacks from Houthi forces in Yemen.

General.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
General.summary: Yemenis are fleeing the escalating war between Houthi rebels and Saudi-backed forces by crossing the Red Sea. BBC correspondent Frank Gardner spoke with refugees who have escaped the conflict to reach Djibouti.

General.title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
General.summary: Dr Vincent Brown, formerly known as Dr Vincent Bajinya, has been charged in the UK with seven offences related to the 1994 Rwanda genocide. The 65-year-old is scheduled to appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Tuesday.

General.title: Flights at major US airports delayed after cable cut by construction workers
General.summary: The cable had been repaired and airports are resuming normal operations, the US transportation secretary says.

General.title: Watch: Police raid organised crime targets in Teesside
General.summary: Cleveland Police carried out one of their biggest raids in years, following the A66 crash that left two officers dead.
